name: BPC-157
description: A synthetic 15-amino-acid peptide (pentadecapeptide) derived from a partial sequence of a protein found in human gastric juice.

name: Pentadeca Arginate
description: A synthetic arginate-salt peptide structurally related to the pentadecapeptide BPC-157.

name: TB-500
description: A synthetic acetylated peptide corresponding to the active actin-binding region of the naturally occurring protein thymosin beta-4.

name: Thymosin Beta-4
description: A naturally occurring 43-amino-acid actin-sequestering protein of the beta-thymosin family.

name: GHK-Cu
description: A copper-binding tripeptide (glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine) complexed with copper(II) ions.

name: KPV
description: A tripeptide (lysine-proline-valine) corresponding to the C-terminal fragment of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone.

name: ARA-290
description: A synthetic 11-amino-acid peptide derived from the helix-B domain of the erythropoietin molecule.

name: Larazotide
description: A synthetic octapeptide that acts as an intestinal tight-junction regulator and zonulin antagonist.

name: LL-37
description: A 37-amino-acid cationic peptide and the only human member of the cathelicidin family of antimicrobial peptides.

name: Ipamorelin
description: A synthetic pentapeptide ghrelin mimetic that selectively agonizes the growth hormone secretagogue receptor.

name: CJC-1295
description: A synthetic analog of growth-hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH), sold with or without a drug-affinity-complex (DAC) modification.

name: Sermorelin
description: A synthetic 29-amino-acid peptide corresponding to the biologically active N-terminal fragment of growth-hormone-releasing hormone.

name: Tesamorelin
description: A synthetic analog of growth-hormone-releasing hormone consisting of the GHRH(1-44) sequence with an N-terminal hexenoyl modification.

name: Hexarelin
description: A synthetic hexapeptide ghrelin mimetic and agonist of the growth hormone secretagogue receptor.

name: GHRP-2
description: A synthetic hexapeptide that acts as an agonist of the growth hormone secretagogue receptor.

name: GHRP-6
description: A synthetic hexapeptide ghrelin mimetic and agonist of the growth hormone secretagogue receptor.

name: MK-677
description: An orally active non-peptide ghrelin mimetic and agonist of the growth hormone secretagogue receptor.

name: MGF
description: A peptide corresponding to a mechanically activated splice variant of insulin-like growth factor 1.

name: PEG-MGF
description: A polyethylene-glycol-conjugated (pegylated) form of the mechano growth factor peptide.

name: IGF-1 LR3
description: A recombinant analog of insulin-like growth factor 1 carrying an arginine substitution and a 13-amino-acid N-terminal extension.

name: Semaglutide
description: A synthetic long-acting analog of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1).

name: Tirzepatide
description: A synthetic dual agonist peptide of the GIP and GLP-1 receptors.

name: Retatrutide
description: A synthetic triple agonist peptide of the GIP, GLP-1, and glucagon receptors.

name: Cagrilintide
description: A synthetic long-acting analog of the pancreatic hormone amylin.

name: Survodutide
description: A synthetic dual agonist peptide of the glucagon and GLP-1 receptors.

name: Mazdutide
description: A synthetic oxyntomodulin analog that dually agonizes the GLP-1 and glucagon receptors.

name: Liraglutide
description: A synthetic acylated analog of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1).

name: AOD-9604
description: A modified fragment of the C-terminus of human growth hormone (residues 176-191) with an added N-terminal tyrosine residue.

name: HGH Fragment 176-191
description: A synthetic peptide corresponding to amino acids 176-191 of the C-terminal region of human growth hormone.

name: Tesofensine
description: A synthetic small-molecule triple reuptake inhibitor of serotonin, noradrenaline, and dopamine.

name: 5-Amino-1MQ
description: A small-molecule inhibitor of the enzyme nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT).

name: SLU-PP-332
description: A synthetic small-molecule pan-agonist of the estrogen-related receptors (ERRs).

name: Epitalon
description: A synthetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) modeled on the pineal-gland peptide complex epithalamin.

name: MOTS-c
description: A 16-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 12S ribosomal RNA gene.

name: SS-31
description: A synthetic mitochondria-targeting tetrapeptide that binds cardiolipin on the inner mitochondrial membrane.

name: Humanin
description: A 24-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S ribosomal RNA gene.

name: NAD+
description: An endogenous pyridine-nucleotide coenzyme (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) central to cellular redox reactions.

name: Thymalin
description: A peptide fraction extracted from the thymus gland belonging to the class of thymic bioregulators.

name: Pinealon
description: A synthetic tripeptide (Glu-Asp-Arg) belonging to the class of short-peptide bioregulators.

name: Semax
description: A synthetic heptapeptide derived from the ACTH(4-10) fragment with an added C-terminal Pro-Gly-Pro motif.

name: Selank
description: A synthetic heptapeptide analog of the endogenous immunomodulatory peptide tuftsin.

name: Dihexa
description: A synthetic oligopeptide derived from the angiotensin IV fragment.

name: Cerebrolysin
description: A mixture of low-molecular-weight peptides and free amino acids derived from purified porcine brain proteins.

name: P21
description: A synthetic peptidomimetic derived from a biologically active region of ciliary neurotrophic factor (CNTF).

name: Argireline
description: A synthetic acetylated hexapeptide modeled on the N-terminal fragment of the SNAP-25 protein.

name: SNAP-8
description: A synthetic acetylated octapeptide that is an elongated analog of acetyl hexapeptide-8.

name: Matrixyl
description: A palmitoylated pentapeptide (Pal-Lys-Thr-Thr-Lys-Ser) derived from a subfragment of type I collagen.

name: Melanotan I
description: A synthetic analog of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH).

name: Melanotan II
description: A synthetic cyclic heptapeptide analog of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH).

name: PT-141
description: A synthetic cyclic heptapeptide melanocortin-receptor agonist.

name: Kisspeptin-10
description: A 10-amino-acid C-terminal fragment of the kisspeptin neuropeptide encoded by the KISS1 gene.

name: Gonadorelin
description: A synthetic decapeptide identical to endogenous gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH).

name: Thymosin Alpha-1
description: A synthetic 28-amino-acid peptide identical to a naturally occurring thymic peptide.

name: Thymulin
description: A nonapeptide thymic hormone that requires bound zinc for its biological activity.

name: DSIP
description: An endogenous nonapeptide (delta sleep-inducing peptide) first isolated from cerebral venous blood.

name: Adipotide
description: A synthetic peptidomimetic that targets prohibitin on the blood vessels supplying white adipose tissue.

name: Follistatin 344
description: A recombinant form of the human follistatin protein (344-amino-acid isoform) that binds and neutralizes activin and myostatin.

name: VIP
description: A 28-amino-acid neuropeptide belonging to the glucagon/secretin peptide superfamily.

name: Oxytocin
description: An endogenous nonapeptide hormone produced in the hypothalamus.

name: Glutathione
description: An endogenous antioxidant tripeptide (gamma-glutamyl-cysteinyl-glycine).
